name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.3 (released 2026-04-30) is the latest stable release, fixing a long-standing DMG signing issue that prevented native modules from loading in packaged macOS builds. The headline v0.4.0 release (433 commits since v0.3.4) introduced a Skills system for installable agent capabilities, a multi-provider BYOK AI runtime supporting 8 CLI providers (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.), a persistent terminal/PTY mode, a redesigned Tasks Board with drag-and-drop, and a full-text search palette. The project also added MIT licensing, anonymous opt-out telemetry, and extensive UX/accessibility improvements. See release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases per day in April 2026, most recently v0.4.3 on 2026-04-30
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Partial — server-side legal/ToS acceptance flow present; no explicit user login/auth system mentioned in changelog

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a more feature-rich document management system with user permissions and workflows, but comes with greater resource overhead compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides robust auto-tagging and OCR pipelines making it more powerful for document organization, but requires more setup effort than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud covers file management and much more through its app ecosystem, but is a far heavier platform compared to Cabinet's minimal footprint.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing across multiple storage backends, but lacks Cabinet's document-management and annotation features.
